description: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/check-route-auth.mjs. A route lands here only if it is genuinely public, authenticates inside a named lib/ function, or re-exports another route. Every entry needs a reason and a reviewed date. Adding an entry is a security decision — review the route before adding it; never add one just to make CI pass.

health.reason: Uptime monitoring (UptimeRobot). Returns only aggregate status from checkHealth().

platform/health.reason: Monitoring endpoint. FOLLOW-UP (low, docs/security/findings.md SEC-2026-10-12-08): returns raw DB error text, AI provider names and queue counts to anonymous callers, and runs 4 service-role queries per hit.

callback.reason: Supabase OAuth/magic-link callback — exchanges the one-time code for a session; there is no user yet.

beta/teacher-count.reason: Marketing counter — reads a single aggregate value from beta_stats.

early-access/register.reason: Pre-signup lead capture form (insert-only into early_access_leads).

insights/newsletter.reason: Public newsletter subscribe form for the Insights blog.

insights/search.reason: Search over published public Insights articles.

academic-clinic/pdf.reason: lib/academicClinic/clinicPdfHandler.ts calls checkFeatureAccess('clinic_report') first and returns 401 on 'unauthenticated'.

teacher/assignments/[id]/print-routes/[p.reason: lib/assignments/printRoutes.ts: requireAuthentication + resolveTeacher + assignment ownership before any write.
lib/assignments/printRoutes.ts: requireAuthentication + resolveTeacher + assignment ownership before any write.

teacher/blueprint/actions/[actionItemId].reason: GET -> getBlueprintActionReviewSnapshot -> requireManageAccess -> canManageLearnerRecordCore (requireAuthentication first in both branches); POST -> reviewBlueprintAction (requireAuthentication, then the same snapshot check). lib/learnerBlueprint/actionPlan/review.ts.

teacher/assignments.reason: GET is guarded directly. POST -> lib/assignments/create.ts::createAssignment -> resolveSoloTarget (requireAuthentication + resolveTeacher + requireClassTeacher) or resolveInstitutionalTarget (requireInstitutionalAssignmentAuthority).

teacher/assignments/[id]/print-routes.reason: GET is guarded directly (requireClassTeacher). POST -> lib/assignments/printRoutes.ts::generatePrintRun: requireAuthentication + resolveTeacher + assignment ownership before any write.

teacher/assignments/[id]/print-routes/[p.reason: GET is guarded directly. PATCH -> lib/assignments/printRoutes.ts::editRouteContent / overrideLearnerRoute, both loadOwnedAssignment -> requireClassTeacher before reading the run.

learner-accounts/claim.reason: Bootstraps a learner's FIRST session, so no prior user exists. Authority = possession of a one-time school-issued activation token validated in lib/core/learnerAccounts.ts; never a client-supplied identity.

whatsapp/inbound.reason: Legacy callback URL; re-exports the signature-verified webhook so either URL registered with Meta works.
